_about.what: GAO High-Risk List, current edition, with an explicit hand-curated agency mapping per area. Input to scripts/painpoints/build-replacement-candidates.ts. NOT served.
_about.verified_how: Area names copied verbatim from https://www.gao.gov/high-risk-list (Current List, 38 areas, 'as of February 2025'); per-area URLs are the anchors GAO links from that page.

mapping_rules.title_named: The area's own title names the agency (e.g. 'DOD Contract Management'). High confidence.
mapping_rules.program_owner: The area names one federal program administered by one agency (e.g. 'Unemployment Insurance System' -> Department of Labor). Mapped, but every candidate is flagged requires_review until a human confirms it against the area chapter.
mapping_rules.multi_agency: GAO describes several agencies sharing the area. NOT mapped to any one agency — a decision for Eric.
mapping_rules.government_wide: The area applies across government. NOT attached to individual agencies (attaching it to all 49 would invent agency-specific claims).

_about.never: No agency in this file was derived by substring matching. Every mapped agency must also resolve exactly through src/lib/strategic-intel/agency-resolver.ts or the candidate is rejected.
